title: A Lightweight Explainable Guardrail for Prompt Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Querying an LLM with two opposing adversarial prompts to test if the model blindly conforms to the user's embedded assumption rather than correctly identifying the ground-truth safety label during synthetic data generation.

Evaluating the F1 score performance of prompt classification and explainability models specifically on the 'Social stereotypes and unfair discrimination' fine-grained safety category within the WildGuardMix dataset.
